```js
	CACHE.set('rates', rates, '1 minute');
}
```

Je to pamäť procesu: reštart ju vyprázdni. Pre hodnotu, ktorá má ostať aj po reštarte, použi `MEMORIZE`.

## Ako spustím náročnú prácu bez blokovania aplikácie?

Vo vlákne. Práca je súbor vo `workers/` a `NEWTHREAD(názov, dáta)` ju spustí:

```js
// workers/sum.js
require('total5');

var worker = NEWTHREAD();
var total = 0;

for (var i = 1; i <= worker.data.max; i++)
	total += i;

worker.postMessage({ total: total });
```

```js
ROUTE('GET /sum/', function($) {
	var worker = NEWTHREAD('sum', { max: 1000 });
	worker.on('message', function(msg) {
		worker.terminate();
		$.json(msg);
	});
});
```

Vo workeri je `NEWTHREAD()` bez názvu samotné vlákno: `worker.data` je to, čo poslala aplikácia.

---

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/questions/sk/helpers.md

# Pomocníci pre texty, čísla, dátumy a zoznamy, cookies, hlavičky a middleware: otázky a odpovede

## Ako spravím slug z textu?

Cez `slug` textu. Odstráni aj diakritiku:

```js
var a = 'Hello World!'.slug();     // hello-world
var b = 'Čaj s mlékom'.slug();     // caj-s-mlekom
```

## Ako overím, že text je e-mail, URL alebo telefón?

Cez `isEmail`, `isURL` a `isPhone` textu. Vo vstupe akcie použi namiesto toho typy `Email`, `URL` a `Phone`.

```js
var ok = 'anna@example.com'.isEmail();          // true
var no = 'anna'.isEmail();                      // false
var url = 'https://www.totaljs.com'.isURL();    // true
var phone = '+421903111222'.isPhone();          // true
```

## Ako zmením text na číslo, dátum alebo objekt?

Cez `parseInt`, `parseFloat`, `parseDate` a `parseJSON` textu. Nevyhadzujú chybu: text, ktorý nie je číslo, dá `0`, a text, ktorý nie je JSON, dá `undefined`.

```js
var count = '12'.parseInt();            // 12
var zero = 'abc'.parseInt();            // 0
var price = '12.5'.parseFloat();        // 12.5
var date = '2026-11-12'.parseDate();    // a Date
var obj = '{"a":1}'.parseJSON();        // { a: 1 }
var none = 'not json'.parseJSON();      // undefined
```

## Ako skrátim text alebo ho napíšem s veľkými začiatočnými písmenami?

`max(dĺžka)` skráti text a ukončí ho `...`; `capitalize()` začne každé slovo veľkým písmenom:

```js
var short = 'A long text of a product'.max(10);    // A long ...
var name = 'anna nowak'.capitalize();              // Anna Nowak
```

## Ako zakódujem text pre HTML?

Cez `encode` textu a `decode` pre cestu späť:

```js
var safe = '<b>x</b>'.encode();     // &lt;b&gt;x&lt;/b&gt;
var html = '&lt;b&gt;'.decode();    // <b>
```

## Ako vypočítam hash textu?

`sha256()` a `md5()` textu vrátia hash v hexadecimálnom tvare; `sha256(soľ)` doň primieša tajomstvo. `hash()` vráti krátke číslo, vhodné ako kľúč, nie na heslo:

```js
var password = model.password.sha256(CONF.secret);
var key = 'text'.hash();    // 3556653
```

## Ako spravím text na vyhľadávanie bez diakritiky?

Cez `toSearch` textu: malé písmená a bez diakritiky. Ulož ho do stĺpca `search` a porovnaj s rovnakým tvarom toho, čo napísal používateľ.

```js
model.search = model.name.toSearch();    // 'Čučoriedka Nowák' becomes 'cucoriedka nowak'
```

## Ako naformátujem číslo?

Cez `format(desatinné)` čísla; oddeľovače tisícov a desatinných miest sú ďalšie dva argumenty. `padLeft`, `round`, `floor` a `filesize` sú tiež metódy čísla:

```js
var a = (1234.5).format(2);              // 1 234.50
var b = (1234.5).format(2, ',', '.');    // 1,234.50
var c = (5).padLeft(3);                  // 005
var d = (1.005).round(2);                // 1.01
var e = (2.567).floor(2);                // 2.56
var f = (1536).filesize();               // 1.50 KB
```

## Ako napíšem množné číslo s číslom?

Cez `pluralize` čísla a štyri texty: pre nulu, jeden, niekoľko a veľa. `#` je číslo:

```js
var text = (3).pluralize('no items', '# item', '# items', '# items');    // 3 items
```

## Ako naformátujem dátum?

Cez `format` dátumu:

```js
var a = NOW.format('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm');    // 2026-11-12 09:05
var b = NOW.format('dd.MM.yyyy');          // 12.11.2026
```

## Ako pripočítam čas k dátumu?

Cez `add` dátumu a text: číslo a jednotka. Vráti nový dátum a pôvodný nemení; záporné číslo ide späť.

```js
var tomorrow = NOW.add('1 day');
var before = NOW.add('-2 hours');
var expire = NOW.add('1 month');
```

## Ako zoradím zoznam objektov?

Cez `quicksort` poľa a názov políčka; `_desc` za názvom zoradí zostupne a viac políčok sa oddelí čiarkou:

```js
items.quicksort('name');
items.quicksort('name_desc');
items.quicksort('age_desc,name');
```

## Ako nájdem, vyfiltrujem a odstránim položky zoznamu?

Cez funkcie poľa, podľa názvu políčka a jeho hodnoty:

```js
var item = items.findItem('id', 'b');                 // the object, or undefined
var index = items.findIndex('id', 'b');               // its position, or -1
var adults = items.findAll('age', 30);                // every object with that value
var name = items.findValue('id', 'b', 'name', '');    // one field of the object, or the default
var rest = items.remove('id', 'a');                   // the list without it
var page = items.skip(20).take(10);
var first = items.first();
var last = items.last();
```

## Ako spravím náhodný text alebo id?

`UID()` je id riadku: krátke a jedinečné. `GUID(dĺžka)` je náhodný text danej dĺžky, na token:

```js
model.id = UID();
model.token = GUID(30);
```

## Ako skopírujem objekt?

Cez `CLONE(obj)`: hlboká kópia, takže zmena kópie sa nedostane do pôvodného objektu.

```js
var copy = CLONE(MAIN.settings);
copy.theme.color = 'red';
```

## Ako zostavím adresu s query stringom?

Cez `QUERIFY(url, obj)`: zakóduje hodnoty.

```js
var url = QUERIFY('/api/', { q: 'a b', page: 2 });    // /api/?q=a%20b&page=2
```

## Ako prečítam a nastavím cookie?

Cez `$.cookie`: jeden argument ju prečíta a s hodnotou sa nastaví. Tretí argument je, ako dlho žije, a štvrtý jej možnosti:

```js
ROUTE('GET /theme/', function($) {
	var theme = $.cookie('theme');
	$.cookie('theme', 'dark', '7 days', { httponly: true });
	$.plain(theme);
});
```

Cookie, ktorá neexistuje, je prázdny text. Na odstránenie ju nastav s časom v minulosti: `$.cookie('theme', '', '-1 day')`.

## Ako prečítam hlavičku požiadavky a nastavím hlavičku odpovede?

Hlavičky požiadavky sú v `$.headers`, s názvami malými písmenami. Hlavičky odpovede sú v `$.response.headers` a jej status v `$.response.status`:

```js
ROUTE('GET /version/', function($) {
	var client = $.headers['x-client'];
	$.response.headers['x-version'] = '1.2.0';
	$.response.status = 201;
	$.json({ client: client });
});
```

## Čo vie požiadavka o klientovi?

`$.ip` je jeho adresa, `$.url` cesta, `$.query` query string ako objekt, `$.method` metóda, `$.mobile` či je to mobil a `$.language` jazyk, ktorý vrátil `LOCALIZE`.

```js
ROUTE('GET /who/', function($) {
	$.json({ ip: $.ip, url: $.url, page: $.query.page, method: $.method, mobile: $.mobile });
});
```

## Ako spustím kód pred routami, ktoré ho potrebujú (middleware)?

Deklaruj ho cez `MIDDLEWARE` v definícii a pomenuj ho v route cez `#`. Zavolá `next()`, aby sa pokračovalo, alebo odpovie a routa sa nespustí:

```js
// definitions/init.js
MIDDLEWARE('onlyjson', function($, next) {
	if (($.headers.accept || '').indexOf('application/json') === -1)
		$.invalid(400);
	else
		next();
});
```

```js
ROUTE('GET /report/ #onlyjson', function($) {
	$.json({ ok: true });
});
```

Na zistenie, kto je používateľ, použi `AUTH`, nie middleware.

## Ako spravím jednu routu pre všetky adresy pod cestou?

Cez `*` na konci cesty. Časti adresy sú v `$.split`:

```js
ROUTE('GET /docs/*', function($) {
	// /docs/guide/install/ gives ['docs', 'guide', 'install']
	$.json($.split);
});
```

Routa odpovie aj na `/docs/`.

---

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/questions/sk/browser.md

# Prehliadač: stav, udalosti, úložisko, požiadavky, nahrávanie a stránky bez načítania: otázky a odpovede

## Ako prečítam a zmením hodnotu odkiaľkoľvek v prehliadači?

Cez `GET(cesta)` a `SET(cesta, hodnota)`. Cesta začína cestou pluginu a každý binding tej cesty sa prekreslí:

```js
var count = GET('counter.count');
SET('counter.count', 10);
```

V plugine použi `exports.get('count')` a `exports.set('count', 10)`.

## Ako zvýšim číslo, prepnem príznak alebo pridám položku do zoznamu?

Cez `inc`, `toggle` a `push` pluginu; zmenia hodnotu a obrazovka sa prekreslí. `INC`, `TOGGLE` a `PUSH` robia to isté zvonka, s celou cestou:

```js
exports.inc('count', 1);
exports.toggle('isopen');
exports.push('items', 'new');

INC('counter.count', 5);
TOGGLE('counter.isopen');
PUSH('counter.items', 'new');
```

## Ako zobrazím alebo skryjem časť obrazovky?

Cez `ui-bind` a `show`: odstráni triedu `hidden`, keď je hodnota pravdivá.

```html
<ui-bind path="?.isopen" config="show" class="hidden">
	<div>@(Details)</div>
</ui-bind>
```

## Ako zareagujem na zmenu hodnoty?

Cez `exports.watch` v plugine alebo `WATCH` s celou cestou. Funkcia dostane novú hodnotu:

```js
exports.watch('count', function(value) {
	console.log(value);
});

WATCH('counter.count', function(value) {
	console.log(value);
});
```

## Ako pošlem udalosť z jedného pluginu do druhého?

`EMIT(názov, a, b)` ju pošle a každé `ON(názov, ...)` ju zachytí, v plugine cez `exports.on`:

```js
// the plugin that listens
exports.on('saved', function(id) {
	exports.refresh();
});

// the one that saved
EMIT('saved', id);
```

## Ako zavolám funkciu iného pluginu?

Cez `EXEC('plugin/funkcia', argumenty)`. Pluginy sú aj v `PLUGINS`:

```js
EXEC('counter/add', el);
PLUGINS.counter.refresh();
```

## Ako uložím hodnotu v prehliadači medzi návštevami?

Cez `CACHE(kľúč, hodnota, expirácia)`; `CACHE(kľúč)` ju prečíta a vráti `null`, keď tam nie je alebo jej čas uplynul. Ukladá sa do `localStorage`:

```js
CACHE('filter', { status: 'open' }, '1 day');
var filter = CACHE('filter');
```

## Ako uložím preferenciu používateľa v prehliadači?

Cez `PREF.set(názov, hodnota, expirácia)`; hodnota je potom vlastnosť `PREF`:

```js
PREF.set('theme', 'dark', '1 month');
var theme = PREF.theme;
```

## Ako prečítam a nastavím cookie v prehliadači?

Cez `COOKIES.get`, `COOKIES.set` a `COOKIES.rem`:

```js
COOKIES.set('language', 'sk', '1 day');
var language = COOKIES.get('language');
COOKIES.rem('language');
```

## Ako zavolám routu servera, ktorá nie je API endpoint?

Cez `AJAX`: metóda a adresa v jednom texte, dáta a callback. Odpoveď je spracovaná a jej dátumy sú objekty `Date`:

```js
AJAX('GET /api/ping/', function(response) {
	console.log(response);
});

AJAX('POST /api/echo/', { name: 'Anna' }, function(response) {
	console.log(response);
});
```

Pre API endpointy pluginu použi `exports.tapi`.

## Ako nahrám súbor z prehliadača s priebehom?

Cez `UPLOAD`: metóda a adresa, `FormData`, callback a funkcia, ktorá dostane percentá:

```js
var data = new FormData();
data.append('file', input.files[0]);

UPLOAD('POST /api/upload/', data, function(response) {
	exports.refresh();
}, function(percentage) {
	exports.set('progress', percentage);
});
```

Routa servera má `@upload` a svoj limit veľkosti.

## Ako spravím stránky v prehliadači bez načítania?

Cez `ROUTE` knižnice: adresa a funkcia, ktorá sa pre ňu spustí. `REDIRECT(url)` prejde na adresu bez načítania:

```js
ROUTE('/products/', function() {
	SET('common.page', 'products');
});

ROUTE('/products/{id}/', function(id) {
	SET('common.page', 'product');
	SET('product.id', id);
});

REDIRECT('/products/abc/');
```

`NAV.url` je aktuálna adresa, `NAV.query` jej query string ako objekt a `NAV.back()` ide späť.

## Ako zdieľam nastavenie medzi časťami rozhrania?

Cez `ENV(názov, hodnota)`; `ENV(názov)` ho prečíta:

```js
ENV('apiurl', '/api/');
var url = ENV('apiurl');
```

## Sú pomocníci pre texty, čísla a dátumy aj v prehliadači?

Áno: knižnica má `format` textu, čísla a dátumu, `GUID`, `QUERIFY` a `NOW`, s rovnakými výsledkami ako na serveri.

```js
var text = 'Hello {0}'.format('Anna');           // Hello Anna
var price = (1234.5).format(2);                  // 1 234.50
var day = NOW.format('yyyy-MM-dd');
var url = QUERIFY('/api/', { q: 'a b' });        // /api/?q=a%20b
var id = GUID(8);
```

---

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/questions/sk/operations.md

# Relácie, Markdown, cache na disku, šablóny, zálohy, údržba, príkazy a audit: otázky a odpovede

## Ako prihlásim používateľov cez reláciu a cookie?

Odovzdaj `AUTH` objekt namiesto funkcie: framework si drží relácie a číta cookie a `onread` načíta používateľa relácie prvýkrát. Objekt si ulož na prihlasovanie a odhlasovanie:

```js
// definitions/auth.js
var opt = {};

opt.secret = CONF.secret;
opt.cookie = 'session';
opt.expire = '5 minutes';
opt.strict = false;

opt.onread = async function(meta, next) {
	var user = await DATA.read('nosql/tbl_user').id(meta.userid).promise();
	if (user)
		next(null, { id: user.id, name: user.name });
	else
		next(404);
};

AUTH(opt);
MAIN.session = opt;
```

`expire` je, ako dlho si framework drží reláciu v pamäti, kým ju znova načíta cez `onread`, nie ako dlho žije cookie. Routa s `+` potom potrebuje prihláseného používateľa, ktorý je v `$.user`.

## Ako prihlásim a odhlásim používateľa?

Po overení hesla nastaví `authcookie` objektu relácie cookie; `logout` odstráni reláciu aj cookie:

```js
NEWACTION('Account|login', {
	name: 'Sign in',
	input: '*email:Email, *password:String',
	action: async function($, model) {
		var user = await DATA.read('nosql/tbl_user').where('email', model.email).promise($);
		if (!user || user.password !== model.password.sha256(CONF.secret)) {
			$.invalid('@(Invalid credentials)');
			return;
		}
		MAIN.session.authcookie($, UID(), user.id, '1 month');
		$.success();
	}
});

NEWACTION('Account|logout', {
	name: 'Sign out',
	action: function($) {
		MAIN.session.logout($);
		$.success();
	}
});
```

```js
ROUTE('-POST /api/login/   --> Account|login');
ROUTE('+GET  /api/logout/  --> Account|logout');
```

Argumenty `authcookie` sú id novej relácie, id používateľa a ako dlho žije cookie.

## Ako prevediem Markdown na HTML?

Cez `markdown` textu. Bez balíčka:

```js
var html = '# Title\n\nSome **bold** text.'.markdown();
```

Výsledok je vnútri `<div class="markdown">`.

## Ako uložím pomalý výsledok do cache na disku?

Cez `FILECACHE`: id, ako dlho platí, callback, ktorý dostane hodnotu, a funkcia, ktorá ju vytvorí, keď žiadna nie je. Na rozdiel od `CACHE` ostane aj po reštarte:

```js
FILECACHE('rates', '1 hour', function(err, rates) {
	$.callback(rates);
}, function(next) {
	RESTBuilder.GET(CONF.ratesurl).callback(next);
});
```

## Ako vykreslím textovú šablónu na serveri?

Cez `TEMPLATE(text, model)`, ktorý vráti promise. Šablóna je Tangular a model je `value`:

```js
var html = await TEMPLATE('<b>{{ value.name }}</b> has {{ value.count }} items', { name: 'Anna', count: 3 });
```

## Ako zálohujem priečinok a obnovím ho?

`BACKUP(súbor, priečinok, callback)` zapíše priečinok do jedného súboru a `RESTORE(súbor, priečinok, callback)` ho zapíše späť:

```js
BACKUP(PATH.root('backup.package'), PATH.root('databases'), function(err, meta) {
	// meta.files and meta.size
});

RESTORE(PATH.root('backup.package'), PATH.root('restored'), function(err, meta) {
});
```

## Ako prepnem aplikáciu do údržby?

Cez `PAUSESERVER(názov, true)`: každá požiadavka dostane 503 až do `PAUSESERVER(názov, false)`. Názov je dôvod, aby sa dva dôvody navzájom nezrušili:

```js
PAUSESERVER('import', true);

importrows(function() {
	PAUSESERVER('import', false);
});
```

## Ako spustím príkaz systému?

Cez `SHELL(príkaz, callback)`; callback dostane chybu a výstup. Nikdy nedávaj do príkazu text od používateľa:

```js
SHELL('df -h', function(err, output) {
	console.log(output);
});
```

## Ako porovnám zoznam z formulára so zoznamom v databáze?

Cez `DIFFARR(políčko, db, formulár)`: povie, čo pridať, čo upraviť a ktoré id odstrániť.

```js
var diff = DIFFARR('id', db, model.items);

// diff.add: the items that are only in the form
// diff.upd: [{ db: item, form: item }] for the items in both
// diff.rem: the ids that are only in the database
```

## Ako stiahnem súbor z iného servera?

Cez `DOWNLOAD(url, súbor, callback)`: uloží odpoveď do súboru.

```js
DOWNLOAD(CONF.reporturl, PATH.root('report.pdf'), function(err, response) {
	if (err || response.status !== 200)
		return;
	// response.size is the size of the file
});
```

## Ako si pošlem e-mailom chybu alebo poznámku?

Cez `LOGMAIL(e-mail, predmet, text)`: jednoduchá správa bez view. Používa poštový server z `config`.

```js
LOGMAIL('admin@example.com', 'Import failed', 'The import stopped at the row 12');
```

V Total.js 5 0.0.19 mu daj text: objekt ako telo zlyhá.

## Ako zaznamenám, kto čo urobil?

Cez `$.audit(správa)` v akcii: zapíše riadok do `logs/audit.log` s používateľom, adresou klienta, URL, akciou a jej dátami.

```js
NEWACTION('Orders|remove', {
	name: 'Remove an order',
	params: '*id:UID',
	action: async function($) {
		await DATA.remove('nosql/tbl_order').id($.params.id).error(404).promise($);
		$.audit('order removed');
		$.success($.params.id);
	}
});
```

## Ako spojím viac skriptov do jedného súboru?

Cez `MERGE` v definícii: adresa výsledku a súbory, ktoré sa hľadajú v `public/js/`. Výsledok je minifikovaný:

```js
// definitions/init.js
MERGE('/js/all.js', 'first.js', 'second.js');
```

```html
<script src="/js/all.js"></script>
```

## Potrebujem build krok na minifikáciu CSS a JavaScriptu?

Nie. Framework minifikuje súbory `.js` a `.css` z `public/` pri ich servírovaní: odstráni komentáre a medzery. Bez bundlera a bez balíčka.

```css
.box { display: flex; border-radius: 4px; }
.box > div { transition: all 0.2s; }
```

```css
.box{display:flex;border-radius:4px}.box>div{transition:all 0.2s}
```

Druhý blok je to, čo dostane prehliadač.

## Ako presmerujem požiadavky z cesty na iný server?

Cez `PROXY(cesta, cieľ)` v definícii. `.copy('replace')` zachová zvyšok adresy: `/remote/hello/` príde na druhý server ako `/hello/`, aj s query stringom:

```js
// definitions/init.js
PROXY('/remote/', 'http://127.0.0.1:8001/').copy('replace');
```

Bez `.copy('replace')` idú všetky adresy pod cestou na koreň cieľa. Druhý server dostane adresu klienta v hlavičke `x-forwarded-for`.

## Ako ochránim požiadavku CSRF tokenom?

Nastav `secret_csrf` v `config`. `$.csrf()` vytvorí token, prehliadač ho pošle späť v hlavičke `x-csrf-token` a middleware ho overí cez `DEF.onCSRFcheck($)`:

```
secret_csrf : change-this-secret
```

```js
// definitions/init.js
MIDDLEWARE('csrf', function($, next) {
	if (DEF.onCSRFcheck($))
		next();
	else
		$.invalid(403);
});
```

```js
ROUTE('GET /token/', function($) {
	$.json({ token: $.csrf() });
});

ROUTE('POST /api/save/ #csrf', function($) {
	$.json({ saved: true });
});
```

V prehliadači vlož token raz do hlavičiek knižnice a každé volanie `AJAX` ho pošle:

```js
AJAX('GET /token/', function(response) {
	DEF.headers['x-csrf-token'] = response.token;
});
```

Token platí 30 minút a len pre adresu a prehliadač, ktoré oň požiadali; bez neho, so zmeneným alebo z iného prehliadača je odpoveď 403. V Total.js 5 0.0.19 vytvor token cez `$.csrf()`: direktíva `@{csrf}` vo view tam zlyhá.

---

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/apps/contacts/readme.md

# Contacts

An API of contacts with Total.js 5: list, read, create, update and remove. The data goes through `DATA` (QueryBuilder) on the embedded NoSQL database (`DATA.find('nosql/tbl_contact')`), so the application needs nothing else to run. It can move to PostgreSQL later by taking the prefix `nosql/` away: see [`apps/contacts-postgresql`](../contacts-postgresql).

**The request it answers:** "Create an API for contacts (name, email and phone) with a token, without a database server."

**The shape:** an application without plugins. It fits a small service with one or two collections. An application that will grow by features is made with plugins.

| File | What it has |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Starts the framework |
| `config` | The name of the application and the token of the API |
| `package.json` | `total5` is the only dependency |
| `controllers/api.js` | The routes of the API, one line each |
| `schemas/contacts.js` | The actions: `Contacts|list`, `Contacts|read`, `Contacts|create`, `Contacts|update`, `Contacts|remove` |
| `definitions/auth.js` | Who the request is: the token of the header `x-token` |
| `test.js` | The tests: they start the application and call every action |

## Run it

```
npm install
node index.js 8000
```

Every request is a `POST` to `/api/` with the header `x-token` and the action in `schema`:

```
POST http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/
x-token: change-this-token
content-type: application/json

{ "schema": "contacts_create", "data": { "name": "Anna", "email": "anna@example.com" } }
```

| Schema | Data | Answer |
|---|---|---|
| `contacts` or `contacts?search=an` | | the contacts, sorted by name |
| `contacts_read/{id}` | | the contact, or 404 |
| `contacts_create` | `name` (required), `email`, `phone` | `{ success: true, value: id }` |
| `contacts_update/{id}` | `name` (required), `email`, `phone` | `{ success: true, value: id }`, or 404 |
| `contacts_remove/{id}` | | `{ success: true, value: id }`, or 404 |

A request without the token is answered with 401, and a wrong field with 400 and the name of the field.

## Test it

```
node test.js
```

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/apps/contacts-postgresql/readme.md

# Contacts on PostgreSQL

The API of [`apps/contacts`](../contacts) with its data in PostgreSQL. Its routes and its authorization are the same files, and its actions are the same code: only the prefix `nosql/` of the table name is gone.

**The request it answers:** "My contacts API has grown: move its data to PostgreSQL."

**The shape:** an application without plugins, with `DATA` (QueryBuilder) on PostgreSQL. An application written with `DATA` from the start moves here by adding the definition of the database and taking the prefix `nosql/` away from its table names; no query is written again.

## What differs from apps/contacts

| File | In `apps/contacts` | Here |
|---|---|---|
| `schemas/contacts.js` | `DATA.find('nosql/tbl_contact')` | `DATA.find('tbl_contact')` |
| `definitions/db.js` | | `require('querybuilderpg').init('default', CONF.database, 1, ERROR('PostgreSQL'));` |
| `config` | | `database : postgresql://user:password@localhost/contacts` |
| `package.json` | | the dependency `querybuilderpg` |
| `database.sql` | | the table `tbl_contact` |
| `definitions/init.js` | | creates the table from `database.sql` the first time the application starts |

`controllers/api.js` and `definitions/auth.js` do not change, and `schemas/contacts.js` changes only in that prefix. A test checks both.

The table has the names of the SQL conventions, which the application used from the start: `tbl_contact`, `id` as `text` filled with `UID()`, `dtcreated` and `dtupdated`.

## Run it

Create the database and write its connection in `config`:

```
createdb contacts
npm install
node index.js 8000
```

The API is the one of `apps/contacts`.

## Test it

The tests need PostgreSQL and a database only for them, because they drop and create the table `tbl_contact` there:

```
createdb knowledge_test
node test.js
```

The connection is at the top of `test.js`. When PostgreSQL does not answer, the tests say `SKIPPED` and end with the code 3.

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/apps/files/readme.md

# Files

An API to upload files and download them with Total.js 5. The files are kept in the file storage of the framework, so the application needs nothing else to run.

**The request it answers:** "Create an API where I can upload files and get an address to download each one."

**The shape:** an application without plugins. The files go to `FILESTORAGE`, which is made for them: it keeps each file with its name, size and type under an id. Records go through `DATA` (see `apps/contacts`); files do not go in a database.

| File | What it has |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Starts the framework |
| `config` | The name of the application and the token |
| `package.json` | `total5` is the only dependency |
| `controllers/api.js` | The routes: the API, the upload and the download |
| `schemas/files.js` | The actions: `Files|list`, `Files|upload`, `Files|remove` |
| `definitions/auth.js` | Who the request is: the token of the header `x-token` |
| `test.js` | The tests: they start the application, upload a real file, download it and remove it |

## The three kinds of route

```js
ROUTE('+API    ?           -files_remove/{id}     --> Files|remove');
ROUTE('+POST   /upload/    @upload <5MB           --> Files|upload');
ROUTE('FILE /download/*.*', download);
```

- The upload is a `POST` with `@upload` (a multipart form) and the biggest size it accepts, `<5MB`. A bigger request is answered with 431.
- The download is a `FILE` route: it has no `+`, so everybody who has the address of a file can read it. The id of a file cannot be guessed.

## Store, read and remove a file

```js
// The uploaded files are in $.files. Each one goes to the storage "files" with a new id
var meta = await $.files[i].fs('files', UID());
// meta: { id, name, size, ext, type, date }

// The list of the stored files
var items = await FILESTORAGE('files').browse().promise($);

// The file as the answer of a request, with its content type
FILESTORAGE('files').http($, { id: id, download: true });

// Remove it
FILESTORAGE('files').remove(id, function(err) { /* err when it does not exist */ });
```

The storage is the folder `databases/fs-files` of the application.

## Run it

```
npm install
node index.js 8000
```

```
curl -H "x-token: change-this-token" -F "file=@photo.jpg" http://127.0.0.1:8000/upload/
```

| Request | Answer |
|---|---|
| `POST /upload/` with one or more files | the stored files, each with its `url` |
| `POST /api/` with `{ "schema": "files" }` | the stored files |
| `POST /api/` with `{ "schema": "files_remove/{id}" }` | `{ success: true, value: id }`, or 404 |
| `GET /download/{id}.{ext}` | the file; with `?download=1` the browser saves it with its name |

The upload, the list and the removal need the header `x-token`. An upload without a file is answered with 400.

## Test it

```
node test.js
```

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/apps/monitor/readme.md

# Monitor

An application that checks websites on a schedule with Total.js 5 and says which ones are down. It remembers the websites and the result of their last check in a small object that the framework keeps in a file.

**The request it answers:** "Create an application that checks every few minutes that my websites answer."

**The shape:** an application without plugins. Its work starts by itself, on a schedule, and not with a request. Its state is small and has no queries: a few websites and their last check. That is what `MEMORIZE` is made for; records that grow and are searched go through `DATA` (see `apps/contacts`).

| File | What it has |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Starts the framework |
| `config` | The name, the token, every how many minutes the websites are checked and how long one has to answer |
| `package.json` | `total5` is the only dependency |
| `controllers/api.js` | The routes of the API |
| `schemas/sites.js` | The actions: `Sites|list`, `Sites|create`, `Sites|remove`, `Sites|check` |
| `definitions/init.js` | The state of the application: `MAIN.monitor = MEMORIZE('monitor', 1000)` |
| `definitions/jobs.js` | The schedule: the check and the reset of the counts at midnight |
| `definitions/auth.js` | Who the request is: the token of the header `x-token` |
| `test.js` | The tests: they start the application and a small server that plays the websites |

## Work on a schedule

```js
// The framework emits "service" every minute, with the number of minutes since the start
ON('service', function(counter) {
	if (counter % CONF.interval === 0)
		ACTION('Sites|check').callback(ERROR('Sites|check'));
});

// Every day at midnight
CRON('0 0 * * *', function() {
	// ...
});
```

- The work itself is an action, `Sites|check`. The schedule only calls it, and the API can call it too (`sites_check`): the same code runs at its time and when someone asks, and it can be tested without waiting.
- `ON('service')` is for "every N minutes". `CRON` is for a time of the day or of the week: `minute hour day month weekday`.
- In Total.js 5 0.0.19 the step form of `CRON` (`*/5 * * * *`) runs every minute, not every five: it is fixed in 0.0.20. With the stable version write the list (`0,15,30,45 * * * *`) or use `ON('service')`.
- No `setInterval` and no package for schedules.

## A request to another server

```js
RESTBuilder.GET(site.url).timeout(CONF.timeout).exec(function(err, response, output) {
	site.status = output && output.status ? output.status : 0;
});
```

`output.status` is the status of the answer. A website that does not answer in time gives 408, and an address where nothing listens gives 0.

## A small state that is kept by itself

```js
MAIN.monitor = MEMORIZE('monitor', 1000);

if (!MAIN.monitor.sites)
	MAIN.monitor.sites = [];
```

`MEMORIZE('monitor')` is an object that is read from `databases/memorize_monitor.json` when the application starts. After a change, `MAIN.monitor.save()` writes it (here one second later; ten seconds without the second argument), and `MAIN.monitor.set(key, value)` changes a key and saves. A test checks that the websites are still there after a restart.

## Run it

```
npm install
node index.js 8000
```

| Schema of `POST /api/` | Data | Answer |
|---|---|---|
| `sites` | | the websites with their last check: `status`, `ms`, `isdown`, `checks`, `failures`, `dtchecked` |
| `sites_create` | `name`, `url` (both required) | `{ success: true, value: id }` |
| `sites_remove/{id}` | | `{ success: true, value: id }`, or 404 |
| `sites_check` | | checks every website now and answers with the list |

Every request needs the header `x-token`.

## Test it

```
node test.js
```

The tests call `sites_check` and do not wait for the schedule. The schedule was checked by hand: with `interval : 1` a website had its first check 60 seconds after the start.

---

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/apps/website/readme.md

# Website

A small website with Total.js 5: a home page, a list of products and a page for each product. The pages are rendered on the server with views and one layout. There is no database: the content is a list in memory.

**The request it answers:** "Create a simple website for a bakery, with a home page and its products."

**The shape:** an application without plugins and without an API. It fits public pages that a person reads. An application with screens to manage data is made with plugins.

| File | What it has |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Starts the framework |
| `config` | The name of the website and the email of the footer |
| `package.json` | `total5` is the only dependency |
| `controllers/default.js` | The routes of the pages and the function of each one |
| `definitions/products.js` | The products, in `MAIN.products` |
| `views/layout.html` | The HTML that every page shares: head, header, footer |
| `views/index.html`, `products.html`, `product.html` | The content of each page |
| `public/css/default.css` | The styles |
| `test.js` | The tests: they start the application and read every page |

## How a page is made

A route calls its function, and the function renders a view with its data:

```js
ROUTE('GET /products/{id}/', product);

function product($) {
	var item = MAIN.products.findItem('id', $.params.id);
	if (!item) {
		$.fallback(404);
		return;
	}
	$.view('product', item);
}
```

The view reads the data as `model` and goes inside `views/layout.html`, where `@{body}` is:

```html
@{title(model.name)}

<h1>@{model.name}</h1>
<p class="price">@{model.price.format(2)} EUR</p>
```

- `@{title(...)}` sets the title of the page; the framework adds the name of the application to it.
- `@{import('meta', 'head', 'default.css')}` in the layout writes the title and loads `public/css/default.css`.
- `@(Text)` marks a text for translation.
- `CONF.name` and `CONF.email` are the settings of the file `config`.

## Run it

```
npm install
node index.js 8000
```

Open `http://127.0.0.1:8000`.

## Test it

```
node test.js
```

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/apps/chat/readme.md

# Chat

A chat room with Total.js 5: the people who are in it and their messages travel over one WebSocket. The page is rendered on the server and uses jComponent 20 for the socket and the list of messages.

**The request it answers:** "Create a chat room where everybody sees the messages at once."

**The shape:** an application without plugins. A WebSocket is the way for the server to tell the browser something without being asked; a page that only asks and gets an answer does not need one (see `apps/website`).

| File | What it has |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Starts the framework |
| `config` | The name of the application and how many messages the room remembers |
| `package.json` | `total5` is the only dependency |
| `controllers/default.js` | The route of the page and the route of the socket, with its function |
| `definitions/init.js` | The messages of the room in `MAIN.messages`, and the components of the interface |
| `views/layout.html`, `join.html`, `chat.html` | The layout, the page that asks for the name and the room |
| `public/css/default.css` | The styles |
| `test.js` | The tests: they start the application and talk in the room with real WebSocket clients |

## The socket on the server

A WebSocket is a route with the method `SOCKET`. Its function receives the socket of the route, `$`, once; the events receive each connection, `client`.

```js
ROUTE('SOCKET /chat/', socket);

function socket($) {

	$.on('open', function(client) {
		client.name = client.query.name;
		client.send({ TYPE: 'history', items: MAIN.messages });   // to this connection
		$.send({ TYPE: 'users', items: users() });                 // to everybody
	});

	$.on('close', function(client) {
		$.send({ TYPE: 'users', items: users() });
	});

	$.on('message', function(client, message) {
		// message is the object that the browser sent
		$.send({ TYPE: 'message', name: client.name, text: message.text, date: new Date() });
	});
}
```

- Messages are objects, sent and received as JSON. Each one has a `TYPE` so that the other side knows what it is.
- `$.connections` has the open connections; when `close` runs, the one that closed is not there any more.
- `client.query` is the query of the address the browser connected to (`/chat/?name=Anna`).
- `client.close(4001)` closes a connection. Here a connection without a name is closed half a second after it opens, when it is completely open.
- What the browser sends is never trusted: the type is checked, the text is trimmed and cut, and the name is the one of the connection, not one that comes in the message.

## The socket in the browser

The component `websocket` connects, connects again when the connection is lost, and gives every message as an event:

```html
<ui-component name="websocket" config="url:/chat/?name=@{encodeURIComponent(model.name)}"></ui-component>
```

```js
ON('message', function(msg) {
	if (msg.TYPE === 'message')
		PUSH('chat.items', msg);
});

SETTER('websocket/send', { TYPE: 'message', text: text });
```

The list is a `ui-bind` with a Tangular template on `chat.items`: adding a message to the model draws it.

## What it does not keep

The messages are in memory (`MAIN.messages`, the last 50): a restart of the application starts an empty room. A room that must keep its messages stores them through `DATA`, as `apps/contacts` stores its contacts.

## Run it

```
npm install
node index.js 8000
```

Open `http://127.0.0.1:8000` in two windows with two names. The first start downloads the components of the interface from `cdn.componentator.com`.

## Test it

```
node test.js
```

The tests talk to the socket. The page was checked in a browser: come in with a name, send a message with Enter and receive the message of another person.

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/apps/board/readme.md

# Board

A board of tasks and notes with Total.js 5, made with plugins. Each feature is a plugin with its routes, its actions, its screen and its form, and the application shows them in a menu.

**The request it answers:** "Create an application to keep my tasks and my notes, where I can add more sections later."

**The shape:** an application with plugins. It fits an application with screens to manage data that will grow by features: a new feature is a new folder in `plugins/`, and nothing else changes. A small API or a website with a few pages does not need plugins.

| File | What it has |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Starts the framework |
| `config` | The name of the application; it listens only on this computer |
| `controllers/default.js` | The route of the page: it gives the layout the plugins that the user can see |
| `definitions/auth.js` | Who the request is: one local user |
| `definitions/init.js` | The components of the interface that the layout loads |
| `views/index.html` | The layout: the menu, a `page` for the screen of each plugin and an `importer` for its form |
| `public/css/default.css` | The styles of the layout |
| `plugins/tasks/`, `plugins/notes/` | The two features |
| `test.js` | The tests: they start the application and call the API of both plugins |

## A plugin

```
plugins/tasks/
	index.js              the name, the icon, the position in the menu and the routes
	schemas/tasks.js      the actions
	public/index.html     the screen
	public/form.html      the form that opens over the screen
```

The routes of a plugin are in its `index.js`, not in `controllers/`:

```js
exports.icon = 'ti ti-check-circle';
exports.name = '@(Tasks)';
exports.position = 1;

exports.install = function() {
	ROUTE('+API    ?    -tasks                   --> Tasks|list');
	ROUTE('+API    ?    +tasks_save              --> Tasks|save');
};
```

The files of `public/` are served under `/_tasks/`. The screen is a `<ui-plugin>` with one `PLUGIN(function(exports) { ... })`: `?.items` is the data of the plugin, `?/create` is `exports.create`, and `exports.tapi('tasks ERROR', callback)` calls the API and shows the error to the user.

The form is a `miniform` that the layout loads with an `importer`. The screen opens it with a model, and the form refreshes the screen after it saves:

```js
// the screen
exports.create = function() {
	SET('formtasks @default', {});
	SET('common.form', 'formtasks');
};

// the form
exports.submit = function(hide) {
	var model = exports.model;
	exports.tapi('tasks_save ERROR', { id: model.id, name: model.name, note: model.note }, function() {
		hide();
		PLUGINS.tasks.refresh();
	});
};
```

## Add a feature

Copy `plugins/notes` to a new folder, change its name, icon and position in `index.js`, and write its actions, screen and form. The layout finds it by itself.

## It has no sign in

One person uses it on their own computer: `$ip : 127.0.0.1` in the config and one user in `definitions/auth.js`. Before other people reach it, write a real check in `AUTH`, as the token of `apps/contacts`.

## Run it

```
npm install
node index.js 8000
```

Open `http://127.0.0.1:8000`. The first start downloads the components of the interface from `cdn.componentator.com`.

## Test it

```
node test.js
```

The tests call the API. The screens were checked in a browser: create, edit, mark as done and remove a task, and create a note.
